# Sitewide marketing continuity v54

Status: ACTIVE REDESIGN

## Design authority

The approved MAIN page is the visual and commercial benchmark for every public marketing page.

MAIN remains immutable. This redesign does not change `docs/index.html` or any locked homepage-specific stylesheet or graphic.

## Commercial architecture

Each page has one buyer-facing job:

- Services: help a prospective client recognize the security decision they need Black Bag Security to support.
- Method: establish confidence that difficult security work will be controlled, visible, evidence-led, and verification-ready.
- Proof: demonstrate that Black Bag Security creates original technical capability, not merely commodity consulting output.
- About: establish who is accountable, why the operating model exists, and why senior technical judgment stays close to the work.
- Contact: make starting an engagement easy and low-friction.

## Continuity rules

All redesigned pages use the approved MAIN `v24` visual language:

- dark high-consequence visual system;
- cyan and acid-green accents;
- large concise titles;
- short decision-oriented support copy;
- one dominant visual argument per section;
- consistent split-grid section rhythm;
- graphics that carry meaning rather than decorate;
- repeated buyer journey from uncertainty to evidence to action;
- clear engagement CTA without sales clutter.

## Content rules

- No generic cybersecurity marketing language.
- No page exists merely to explain the company.
- Innovation is presented through client consequence and capability.
- Proof is the public label for engineering and research capability.
- The public site does not use the old Arsenal label in visible copy.
- Main page copy, order, graphics, and styling remain unchanged.
